posts.title: A paste-y journey - finding a pastebin candidate to use

posts.title: IPv6 delegation, an unusually subtle failure mode
posts.description: Running a custom x64 router has a lot of upsides. One, it runs mainline Linux, so it gets updates quickly. Two, router adblocking. 'Nuff said. And three, if something breaks, you get to dive in deep and figure out what's going wrong. This week, I had a really interesting time with my custom setup.
